final: WITH g AS (SELECT ili.order_item_id AS oi, c.town_city AS town, AVG(ili.product_price) AS ap, AVG(ili.derived_product_cost * 1.0 / ili.derived_total_cost) AS ar FROM Invoice_Line_Items ili JOIN Order_Items oi ON oi.order_item_id = ili.order_item_id JOIN Orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN Customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id GROUP BY ili.order_item_id, c.town_city), t AS (SELECT town, AVG(ap) AS avg_price, AVG(ar) AS avg_ratio FROM g GROUP BY town), ov AS (SELECT AVG(avg_ratio) AS overall FROM t) SELECT t.town, t.avg_price, t.avg_ratio, t.avg_ratio - ov.overall AS diff FROM t JOIN ov ON ov.overall IS NOT NULL WHERE t.avg_ratio > ov.overall
